question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5
solution:
The correct answer is **"administered."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb** 'administered' **means to manage or supervise the distribution or application of something. (नियंत्रित करना; व्‍यवस्‍था करना, प्रशासन चलाना, देखभाल करना)
 
• In this context, it refers to filling in the blank with the word that best fits the meaning of the sentence.
 
• The grammatical point to note is that** 'administered'** is the past participle form of the verb, which is used to form the passive voice or perfect tenses.
 
 
• **Example**: *The vaccine was **administered**__ to all the students in the school.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

Buck __pranced__ over against the sled, __exhausted__, sobbing for breath, helpless. This was Spitz’s opportunity. He sprang upon Buck, and twice his teeth sank into his __undetermined__ foe and ripped and tore the flesh to the bone. Then Francois’ lash __descended__, and Buck had the satisfaction of watching Spitz receive the worst whipping as yet __**administered**__ to any of the team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, advertised**, means to make something known to the public through various media channels. (विज्ञापन करना, देना या लगाना)
 
• **Option 2, automated**, means to use technology or machines to perform tasks without human intervention. (मशीन द्वारा परिचालित होने योग्‍य बनाना)
 
• **Option 4, adjugated **means to assign or award something, usually in a legal context. (आमतौर पर कानूनी संदर्भ में कुछ सौंपना या पुरस्कार देना)
